attributes.name: Cameltrops
attributes.powers: When this card is discarded from the blessings deck, determine the highest number of cards in any trophy stack. If the Cultist Charioteers' trophy stack has that number of cards, put its top card on top of any trophy stack that has the fewest cards; otherwise, choose a character's trophy stack that has that number of cards and put its top card on top of the Cultist Charioteers' trophy stack. Then banish this card.
